meta.title: Amaḏal apunik, ɣer berra n Qarṭaǧ
meta.desc: Motyé, Tharros, Nora, Ibiza, Malte, Leptis Magna, Lixus : azeṭṭa n timdinin tifiniqiyin d tipuniyin n ugmur, azday-nsent akked Qarṭaǧ akked wayen i nẓer ass-a.
hero.title: Ɣer berra n Qarṭaǧ
hero.lede: Seg Sicile armi d Ugaraw n Turuft, tnac n timdinin țmeslayent tapunikt qedrent Melqart. Qarṭaǧ mačči weḥd-s : tella d aqerru n uzeṭṭa.
hero.alt: Abrid aqdim yettwaẓeṛẓen deg lxrab n Tharros, Sardaigne
hero.caption: Tharros, ɣef tigzirt tamecṭuḥt n Sinis (Sardaigne)
keys.0.t: n timdinin d yimukan ițwaseknen, seg Sicile armi d Marok agraɣlan
keys.1.t: send Ɛisa : Iqarṭaǧiyen akked Yitruskiyen nnuɣen akked Iphocéens di Alalia (Hérodote, I, 166)
keys.2.t: send Ɛisa : Denys n Syracuse yeṭṭef yehdem Motyé (Diodore, XIV)
keys.3.t: lmeqdem Barthélemy yefra agemmay afiniqi s izran n Malte
rel.title: Qarṭaǧ akked timdinin-nniḍen tipuniyen
rel.intro: Tanazduɣin tifiniqiyin n ugmur llant aṭas n tikwal qbel Qarṭaǧ s yiman-is. Seg lqern wis 6, mi Ṣur teḍεef, Qarṭaǧ tuɣal d taneɣlaft : tezgi amenɣi, tesfara lemɛahda, tesres kra n timdinin ddaw n lḥekma-ines.
rel.rows.0.val: Malchus yennuɣ di Sicile imbeɛd yerreẓ di Sardaigne ; Imagoniden ɛawanen asteεmer n tegzirt (Justin, XVIII, 7 ; XIX, 1).
rel.rows.1.val: Di Alalia, ɣef lebḥer n Corse, lebḥer aqarṭaǧi akked wuyitrusk yegri zdat Iphocéens (Hérodote, I, 166) : Qarṭaǧ tettwali d tamsellekt n Yifiniqiyen n ugmur.
rel.rows.2.val: Lemɛahda akked Ṛuma sekkṛent Sardaigne d Libya i yimsezzenzen iṛumaniyen. Win n 348 yettwag s yisem n Yiqarṭaǧiyen, Iṣuriyen akked yimezdaɣ n Utique (Polybe, III, 22-24).
rel.rows.3.val: Amtawa n Hanibal akked Philippe V yefraq Qarṭaǧ, Utique, akked « timdinin d yigduden ddaw n Yiqarṭaǧiyen » (Polybe, VII, 9) : imdukkal d iḍfan.
rel.rows.4.val: Sabatino Moscati yettwali deg-s « tadukkli » ur neshel ara, i yesεafayen Qarṭaǧ zdat Ṛuma. Imesnezruyen-nniḍen qqaren-d lḥekma, neɣ ula d tagelda deg leqrun wis 4–3. Awalen mazal-iten ttwasmeyyan.
status.title: Anwa i yeḍfaren wi ?
status.items.0.d: Utique akked Gadir, tasersayin n Ṣur zik akteṛ n Qarṭaǧ, ḥeznent lemḥekmen-nsent akked imahlen-nsent.
status.items.1.d: Ebusus (Ibiza), Lilybée neɣ Carthagène ttwasersent sɣur Qarṭaǧ s yiman-is.
status.items.2.d: Diodore (XX, 55) yessawel akka i yimezdaɣ n timdinin n rrif yeqqnen ɣer Yiqarṭaǧiyen s zzwaǧ, ger Iqarṭaǧiyen, Ilibikiyen akked Inumidiyen.
status.items.3.d: Akken i d-yeqqar Tite-Live (XXXIV, 62), Leptis tettaɣ i Qarṭaǧ yiwen uṭalant deg wass. Timdinin ttaken daɣen lbabura d yiɛeskriyen.
status.note: Awalen igrikiyen d ilatiniyen (« imdukkal », « iḍfan ») d wid n yimerbaḥ ; ulac aɣbalu apunik i d-yeḥkan anagraw-agi seg daxel.
grid.title: Timdinin n umaḏal apunik
grid.aside: Yal tamdint : asers-ines, tawuri-ines, akked wayen izmer ad t-nẓer ass-a. Hispanya n At Barka (Carthagène, Sagonte) akked yimukan n Tunisia llan deg usebter « Imukan ».
regions.si.title: Sicile
regions.si.intro: Mi d-ffɣen Igrikiyen, Ifiniqiyen dduklen deg ugmur n tegzirt, qrib yimdukkal-nsen Yelymiyen (Thucydide, VI, 2). Qarṭaǧ tekemmel tenneɣ ɣef Sicile akked Syracuse azal n sin iqrunen, uqbel ad tt-texsar i Ṛuma deg 241 (Polybe, I, 62-63).
regions.sa.title: Sardaigne
regions.sa.intro: Lxiwanat ifiniqiyen seg lqern wis 8, imbeɛd tanyafit taqarṭaǧit deg lqern wis 6. Tigzirt tefka irden d lmɛadin ; Qarṭaǧ teǧǧa-tt i Ṛuma deg 238/237, mbeɛd amennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen (Polybe, I, 88).
regions.ib.title: Ibiza, Jzayer Baléares akked Gadir
regions.ib.intro: Gadir, taqdimt akteṛ, teqqim d tamddakelt tilellit ; Ebusus, i d-tesres Qarṭaǧ, teqqim-as d tamεazit armi d tagara ; Majorque akked Minorque, werǧin ttusteεmer, fkant imegrragen.
regions.mt.title: Malte akked Gozo
regions.mt.intro: Asteεfu deg wammas n ucenfiṛ n Sicile, ɛawanen deg-s Ifiniqiyen seg lqern wis 8, imbeɛd deg lḥekma n Qarṭaǧ. Iṛumaniyen ṭṭfen-tt seg tazwart n umenɣi apunik wis sin, deg 218 (Tite-Live, XXI, 51).
regions.ly.title: Libya : Tripolitaine
regions.ly.intro: « Emporia » n Tiflilt Tameẕyant : krad n lebḥura — syen i d-yekka yisem Tripolitaine — deg tama n tikerraven n Ssaḥra. Qarṭaǧ teḥrez dinna ticraf zdat Yigrikiyen n Cyrène.
regions.mg.title: Rrif n Lezzayer akked Marok
regions.mg.intro: Tabdart n yimukan n usteεfu armi d Ugaraw n Turuft. Aṭas uɣalen imbeɛd d ixxamen n yigelliden inumidiyen d yimurẖiyen, i yeḥezzen tutlayt d yimahlen ipuniyen.
places.motya.name: Motyé (Mozia)
places.motya.text: Tigzirt tamecṭuḥt yettwaḥeznen n ilem n Stagnone, yeqqen ɣer tama s webrid. Lebḥer afiniqi agejdan n ugmur n Sicile armi d aɣelli-ines sɣur Denys n Syracuse deg 397.
places.motya.today: Tigzirt-asinag (tasersayt n Whitaker) : lesswar, tofet, « kothon », akked umεellem n Motyé i d-yettwafen deg 1979.
places.lilybee.name: Lilybée (Marsala)
places.lilybee.alt: Lxrab n lbabur apuni n Marsala
places.lilybee.text: Tettwasers iwakken ad teṭṭef wid i yeddren seg Motyé (Diodore, XXII, 10). Tegri zdat Pyrrhus deg 276 imbeɛd zdat uḥeṛṣ aṛumani iɣezzif seg 250 armi d 241 (Polybe, I, 42-48).
places.lilybee.today: Deg usinag Baglio Anselmi, lxrab n lbabur n umenɣi apuni.
places.panorme.name: Panorme (Palerme)
places.panorme.text: « Lebḥer meṛṛa » i Yigrikiyen, Ṣyṣ ɣef idrimen ipuniyen. Amḍiq n lεesker aqarṭaǧi di Sicile : dinna i yers Hamilkar uqbel Himère deg 480 (Hérodote, VII, 165-167). Iṛumaniyen ṭṭfen-tt deg 254 (Polybe, I, 38).
places.panorme.today: Aẓekka apuni ameqqran ddaw n temdint tatrart ; tiɣawsiwin deg usinag Antonino Salinas.
places.solonte.name: Solonte (Solunto)
places.solonte.alt: Tigejdal d lεerḍ ɣef lebḥer seg lxrab n Solonte
places.solonte.text: Yiwet seg krad n timdinin tifiniqiyin i yettwabedren sɣur Thucydide. Deg 397, tella gar wid idrusen i yeqqimen qeddcen Qarṭaǧ (Diodore, XIV, 48). Tettwabna daɣen deg lqern wis 4 ɣef wedrar Catalfano.
places.solonte.today: Tamdint tihellenistit tiṛumanit s tsidasin nnig lebḥer, s uxxam amecṭuḥ n tɣawsiwin.
places.eryx.name: Éryx (Erice)
places.eryx.text: Tamdint talymit, ɣur-s amḍiq iqeddsen n Astarté ițwassnen, Aphrodite n Yigrikiyen. Hamilkar Barka yeḥeṣṣen dinna seg 244 armi d 241 zdat Iṛumaniyen (Polybe, I, 58).
places.eryx.today: Lesswar alymo-ipuniyen, kra n yizdaɣen-nsen ɛemmṛen s isekkilen ifiniqiyen i gzemen ibennayen.
places.nora.name: Nora
places.nora.alt: Tagejdit d lxrab n wemḍiq n Nora, Pula
places.nora.text: Ɣef wecnefriw qrib Pula. Pausanias (X, 17, 5) yeḥseb-itt d tamdint taqdimt akteṛ n tegzirt. Azru n Nora, yettwafen deg 1773, yesεa abdar aqdim akteṛ yettwassnen n yisem n Sardaigne.
places.nora.today: Amḍiq asenfarrutan ɣer rrif n lebḥer : igrawen ipuniyen ddaw n ṭṭiyaṭru, lḥamamat akked lmuzayikat tiṛumaniyin.
places.tharros.name: Tharros
places.tharros.text: Ɣer tagara n tigzirt tamecṭuḥt n Sinis, zdat ugaraw n Oristano. Tamdint tapunit tameqqrant : tofet-ines akked yimḍalen-ines fkan-d lǥawahar n ddheb akked tkebraṛ aṭas.
places.tharros.today: Amḍiq asenfarrutan yeldin, tεeǧǧeb-it tgejdal-ines ; wayen i d-yettwafen di Cagliari akked Cabras.
places.sulcis.name: Sulcis (Sant'Antioco)
places.sulcis.text: Yiwet seg tasersayin tifiniqiyin iqdimen akteṛ n Sardaigne, ɣef tigzirt yeqqnen ɣer tama. Deg 258, lebḥer aqarṭaǧi yettwanɣelb deg waman n Sardaigne (Polybe, I, 24).
places.sulcis.today: Tofet, imḍalen s texxamin ittwagezmen deg wezru, akked usinag Ferruccio Barreca.
places.sirai.name: Monte Sirai
places.sirai.text: Amḍiq afiniqi ɣef tiɣilt yeεlan tama n Sulcis, yettwabeddel d lqelɛa deg zzman aqarṭaǧi. ADN n yimḍalen-is yettwamseɛdal akked win n yimukan-nniḍen ipuniyen.
places.sirai.today: Lqelɛa, ixxamen, aẓekka akked tofet, qrib Carbonia.
places.bithia.name: Bithia
places.bithia.text: Lebḥer amecṭuḥ n rrif n unzul, qrib Chia. Yettwassen s wemḍiq-ines iqeddsen n yillu Bes, anida ttwafen meyyat n tugniwin n talaḥt n usfel.
places.bithia.today: Lxrab irqaqen ɣef tama n tazugert n Chia ; tugniwin deg usinag n Cagliari.
places.ebusus.name: Ebusus (Ibiza)
places.ebusus.alt: Aẓekka n Puig des Molins, Ibiza
places.ebusus.text: Diodore (V, 16) yesres asers-ines sɣur Qarṭaǧ 160 n iseggasen mbeɛd win n taneddawt ; tanazduɣt tafiniqit tamezwarut tella deg Sa Caleta. Temεaz armi d 206, mi Magun yesteεfu dinna (Tite-Live, XXVIII, 37).
places.ebusus.today: Puig des Molins akked Sa Caleta, ttwajerden deg UNESCO akked Dalt Vila.
places.baleares.name: Majorque akked Minorque
places.baleares.text: Werǧin ttusteεmer, tigzirin-agi n tgemmi talayotique zzenzent i Qarṭaǧ imegrragen-nsent, ɛemmṛen deg ddunit taqdimt akk (Diodore, V, 17-18). Magun yezgi ccetwa di Minorque deg 206 ; tamacahut tefka-yas isem n Mahón.
places.baleares.today: Talayots akked tuddar n zzman aqdim ; azwel n « lmersa n Magun » yeqqim d tamacahut.
places.gadir.name: Gadir (Cadix)
places.gadir.text: Tasersayt n Ṣur ɣef tigzirt, ɣur-s lǥameɛ n Melqart ițwassnen deg ddunit aqdim akk. Tamddakelt n Qarṭaǧ, tedda ɣer Ṛuma deg 206 (Tite-Live, XXVIII, 37).
places.gadir.today: Deg usinag n Cadix, sin lkafen n welɣem n wemdan ifiniqiyen, i d-yettwafen deg 1887 akked 1980.
places.malte.name: Malte akked Gozo (Melitē, Gaulos)
places.malte.text: Imḍalen akked lfexxaṛ sbeggnen-d lḥuḍur afiniqi seg lqern wis 8. Deg 218, taɛessast taqarṭaǧit n azal n 2000 n yirgazen tefka iman-is i Iṛumaniyen (Tite-Live, XXI, 51).
places.malte.today: Imḍalen ipuniyen deg aṭas n yimukan n tegzirt ; izran deg Usinag agraɣlan n tsenfarrut n La Valette.
places.tassilg.name: Tas-Silġ
places.tassilg.alt: Lxrab n wemḍiq iqeddsen n Tas-Silġ, Malte
places.tassilg.text: Ɣef tiɣilt nnig Marsaxlokk, lǥameɛ amegalitik i d-xeddmen daɣen Ifiniqiyen i Astarté, imbeɛd yettwaqdar d amḍiq n Junon deg zzman aṛumani — Cicéron yesmaẓẓaɛ Verrès imi t-yekkes (Verrines, II, 4, 103).
places.tassilg.today: Amḍiq yettwakecfen sɣur tarbaɛt tiṭalyanin seg 1963 ; akeččum yegdel aṭas.
places.leptis.name: Leptis Magna
places.leptis.text: Akken i d-yeqqar Salluste (Jugurtha, 78), tettwasers sɣur iɣerban n Ṣaydun. Lebḥer arikan akteṛ n Emporia, i yettbεaden Masinisa akked Qarṭaǧ. Tapunikt teqqim dinna d tutlayt taɣelnawt ddaw n Ṛuma : ṭṭiyaṭru yesεa tira s snat n tutlayin sɣur Annobal Tapapius Rufus (1-2 mbeɛd Ɛisa).
places.leptis.today: Yiwet seg timdinin tiṛumaniyin iḥerzen akteṛ deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan, tamurt n Septime Sévère (UNESCO).
places.sabratha.name: Sabratha
places.sabratha.text: Tamezwarut d asteεfu n lawan, imbeɛd d tamdint tapunit. Azekka-ines « B », s yiḥedrayen d ismal ihellanen (lqern wis 2 send Ɛisa), d lxedma tufrint n uɣerbaz apunik.
places.sabratha.today: Ṭṭiyaṭru aṛumani s krad iḥedrayen n tgejdal akked uzekka apunik yettwasnefles (UNESCO).
places.oea.name: Oea (Tripoli)
places.oea.text: Tamdint tis krad n Emporia, Wyʿt ɣef idrimen-is ipuniyen. Tewrit mbeɛd isem n tmurt, Tripolis, « krad timdinin » — syen i d-yekka Tripoli.
places.oea.today: Drus n lxrab iban ddaw n Lmedina, siwa taɛerqubt n Marc Aurèle (lqern wis 2 mbeɛd Ɛisa).
places.hippo.name: Hippo Regius (Annaba)
places.hippo.text: Axxam n ttjara apunik, yuɣal d « agellanan » d axxam n yigelliden inumidiyen. Augustin yella d lmeqdem-ines yemmut dinna deg 430 ; yeqqar-d belli tapunikt mazal-itt tettwameslay deg tuddar.
places.hippo.today: Amḍiq n Hippone : forum, lḥamamat, agraw amasiḥi akked usinag.
places.icosium.name: Icosium (Lezzayer)
places.icosium.text: Isem apunik yebda s ʾy, « tigzirt », ahat ɣef ddemma n tigzirin n lebḥer-is. Igrikiyen sellen dinna amḍan uɛecrin (eikosi) snulfan-d uɛecrin yimdukkal n Hercule (Solin) : azwel n uwalen kan.
places.icosium.today: Idlal iqdimen d-yeḍhiṛen deg ikecfan n wemkan n Imcuhada, deg Lqasba yeɣlin.
places.iol.name: Iol / Césarée (Cherchell)
places.iol.text: Lebḥer apunik, imbeɛd taneddawt n Juba II akked Cléopâtre Séléné, yettwasemma Caesarea azal n 25 send Ɛisa. Sin-agi igelliden ḥeznen dinna lferḥ n tira.
places.iol.today: Asinag n Cherchell akked tugniwin-is ; lḥamamat, uḥric akked lebḥer n zzman aqdim.
places.lixus.name: Lixus (Larache)
places.lixus.text: Ɣef tiɣilt yeεlan ɣef uɣzaz n Loukkos. Pline (XIX, 63) yesres dinna amḍiq iqeddsen n Hercule-Melqart aqdim akteṛ n win n Gadès ; tamacahut tesres dinna uglan n Hespérides.
places.lixus.today: Lqelɛa, lǥwameɛ akked lmeεamel timeqqranin n uqqes n zzman aṛumani.
places.mogador.name: Mogador (Essaouira)
places.mogador.text: Asteεfu afiniqi unzul akteṛ yettwassnen ɣef Ugaraw n Turuft : ikufan d tira n lqern wis 7. Imbeɛd, Juba II yexdem dinna aẓeɛfran (Pline, VI, 201). Kra ttwalin deg-s Cerné n Hanun — tiktit tettwasmeyya.
places.mogador.today: Tigzirt, zdat temdint, d amḍiq n tnezmert yegdel i lɣaci.
motya.title: Motyé, tamdint yettwasfaḏen sɣur Denys
motya.rows.0.val: Ifiniqiyen rsen ɣef tigzirt tamecṭuḥt n San Pantaleo, deg ilem arqaq, yeqqen ɣer tmurt s webrid.
motya.rows.1.val: Denys Amɣar n Syracuse yeddu ɣer temdint. Imezdaɣ gezmen abrid (Diodore, XIV, 47-48).
motya.rows.2.val: Isiciliyen ɛemmṛen ilem sεeddayen tsidasin n uḥeṛṣ n sețța iḥedrayen akked isebbaren, leslaḥ amaynut i d-yettwaheggan di Syracuse (XIV, 42 ; 50-51). Himilcon ur yezmir ara ad yesserreḥ i lqelɛa. Tamdint tettwaṭṭef abrid abrid, imezdaɣ-is ttwanɣan neɣ ttwazenzen (XIV, 53).
motya.rows.3.val: Himilcon yeqbal daɣen tigzirt, maca Iqarṭaǧiyen sedduklen wid i yeddren ɣef tama taqrib, di Lilybée (XIV, 55 ; XXII, 10).
motya.rows.4.val: Joseph Whitaker, amsezzenz n ccṛab n Marsala, yesεa tigzirt yezgi ikecfan imezwura ; tirzawin n tesdawit La Sapienza (L. Nigro) ttwalin deg « kothon » agelmim iqeddsen wala lebḥer.
motya.src: Aɣbalu agejdan : Diodore n Sicile, Axxam n yidlisen n umezruy, adlis XIV.
motya.alt: Agelmim n « kothon » n Motyé, Sicile
motya.caption: « Kothon » n Motyé akked lǥameɛ n tama-s
read.title: Izran i yesselɣan Ifiniqiyen ad meslayen
read.paragraphs.0: Sin izran n lmermer, i d-yettwafen qrib Marsaxlokk deg tagara n lqern wis 17, sɛan yiwet tira s tefiniqit d tegrikit : sin watmaten, Abdosir akked Osirshamar, snemmiren dinna « Melqart, bab n Ṣur » (lqern wis 2 send Ɛisa).
read.paragraphs.1: Deg 1758, lmeqdem Jean-Jacques Barthélemy yebna ɣef yismawen n uḏris agrikan iwakken ad yesnilem isekkilen ifiniqiyen : agemmay yefra. Yiwen seg izran, yettunefken i Louis XVI sɣur umeqqran n ssayef n Malte, yella deg Louvre ; wayeḍ, di La Valette.
read.paragraphs.2: Azru n Nora, yettwafen di Sardaigne deg 1773, d yiwet seg tira tifiniqiyin iqdimen akteṛ n ugmur (lqern wis 9-8) ; nɣer dinna isem ŠRDN, Sardaigne.
read.gloss: « I bab-nneɣ, i Melqart, bab n Ṣur » — tazwart n tsnemmirt n izran.
read.altCippus: Azru n Melqart, azru n lmermer s tira s snat n tutlayin, asinag n Louvre
read.altNora: Azru n Nora deg usinag asenfarrutan n Cagliari
read.capNora: Azru n Nora, asinag n Cagliari
map.title: Amḍiq apunik akked yiberdan-ines
sources.text: Thucydide (VI, 2), Hérodote (I, 166 ; VII, 165-167), Polybe (I ; III, 22-24 ; VII, 9), Diodore (V, 16-18 ; XIV ; XX, 55 ; XXII, 10), Tite-Live (XXI, 51 ; XXVIII, 37 ; XXXIV, 62), Salluste (Jugurtha, 78), Pline Amɣar (VI, 201 ; XIX, 63), Pausanias (X, 17), Cicéron (Verrines). Lxedmat timaynutin : S. Moscati, S. Lancel, M. H. Fantar, L. Nigro.
related.0.title: Ɣef yiḍaren n Qarṭaǧ
related.0.text: Carthagène, Kerkouane, Byrsa, Cannes : imukan ara tzurem.
related.1.title: Asers
related.1.text: Ṣur, Elisa akked uzeṭṭa afiniqi n ugmur uqbel Qarṭaǧ.
related.2.title: Tadamsa
related.2.text: Iberdan n lmɛadin, lebḥura akked lemɛahda akked Ṛuma.
related.3.title: Tutlayt d tira
related.3.text: Tapunikt, seg uzru n Nora armi d Augustin.
